metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'MDE - PsExec-Style Service Execution'

properties.description:
Detects the two structural markers of PsExec-style lateral movement: the
PsExec service binary (PSEXESVC.exe) executing, or the service control manager
spawning a child whose command line references an administrative share
(ADMIN$ / IPC$). Reusing a Windows service to run a remote payload is the
oldest lateral-movement primitive on Windows (T1569.002) and is used by
commodity ransomware affiliates and red teams alike.

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{InitiatingProcessFileName}} launched {{FileName}} on {{DeviceName}} with a command line referencing an administrative share: {{ProcessCommandLine}}
